me.kaiyan.missilewarfare.missiles

Class ElytraMissileController

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.kaiyan.missilewarfare.missiles.ElytraMissileController

  • public class ElytraMissileController
extends java.lang.Object
    Controls the flight behaviour and tracking logic for anti-elytra missiles that home in on players using elytras.
